mapper.sql: c.card_id, c.card_type, c.card_name, c.card_status, c.pass_type, c.issue_reason, c.remark, c.person_id, c.car_id, c.biostar_card_id, c.biostar_card_value, c.use_yn, c.del_yn, c.reg_dt, c.mod_dt, CONVERT(varchar(10), c.fee_paid_dt, 23) AS fee_paid_dt, CONVERT(varchar(10), c.issue_dt, 23) AS issue_dt, CONVERT(varchar(10), c.lost_dt, 23) AS lost_dt, CONVERT(varchar(10), c.return_dt, 23) AS return_dt, cdt.code_name AS card_type_name, cs.code_name AS card_status_name, pt.code_name AS pass_type_name, car.car_no AS car_no

ORDER BY
c.biostar_card_value DESC, c.card_id c.card_name DESC, c.card_id cs.code_name DESC, c.card_id c.reg_dt DESC, c.card_id c.card_id DESC

FROM tb_card c LEFT JOIN tb_common cdt ON cdt.cmm_id = 'CDT' AND cdt.code_id = c.card_type LEFT JOIN tb_common cs ON cs.cmm_id = 'CS' AND cs.code_id = c.card_status LEFT JOIN tb_common pt ON pt.cmm_id = 'PT' AND pt.code_id = c.pass_type LEFT JOIN tb_car car ON car.car_id = c.car_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_card SET car_id = #{carId}, use_yn = 'Y', del_yn = 'N', mod_dt = getdate() WHERE card_id = #{cardId}
mapper.select:
SELECT
c.del_yn = 'N' AND c.person_id IS NULL AND c.car_id IS NULL
AND (c.biostar_card_value LIKE '%' + #{keyword} + '%' OR c.card_name LIKE '%' + #{keyword} + '%')
ORDER BY c.biostar_card_value
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_card (card_type, card_name, card_status, pass_type, fee_paid_dt, issue_dt, issue_reason, remark, person_id, car_id, biostar_card_id, biostar_card_value) VALUES (#{cardType}, #{cardName}, #{cardStatus}, #{passType}, #{feePaidDt}, getdate(), #{issueReason}, #{remark}, #{personId}, #{carId}, #{biostarCardId}, #{biostarCardValue})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_card SET person_id = #{personId}, car_id = NULL, use_yn = 'Y', del_yn = 'N', card_type = #{cardType}, card_name = #{cardName}, card_status = #{cardStatus}, pass_type = #{passType}, fee_paid_dt = #{feePaidDt}, issue_reason = #{issueReason}, remark = #{remark}, mod_dt = getdate() WHERE card_id = #{cardId}

UPDATE tb_card SET card_type = #{cardType}, card_name = #{cardName}, card_status = #{cardStatus}, pass_type = #{passType}, fee_paid_dt = #{feePaidDt}, issue_reason = #{issueReason}, remark = #{remark}, mod_dt = getdate() WHERE card_id = #{cardId}
UPDATE tb_card SET del_yn = 'Y', mod_dt = getdate() WHERE card_id = #{cardId}
UPDATE tb_card SET person_id = NULL, use_yn = 'Y', del_yn = 'N', mod_dt = getdate() WHERE person_id = #{personId} AND del_yn = 'N'
